marketplace.summary: Estimates, triangulates and interprets tumor immune microenvironment composition from bulk transcriptomes via CIBERSORT-style deconvolution, ssGSEA, ESTIMATE and consensus subtyping, without treating scores as measured infiltration or making patient-level claims.

skills.name: tumor-immune-infiltration-diagnostic-ml-research-planner
skills.description: Plans tumor immune-infiltration-guided bulk-transcriptome biomarker and diagnostic-ML studies with four workload tiers, dependency maps and verified references.

skills.name: cibersort-immune-infiltration-analysis
skills.description: Runs local CIBERSORT-style nu-SVR deconvolution against LM22 to estimate relative immune-cell fractions with permutation p-values and a case-vs-control test.

skills.name: ssgsea-immune-infiltration-analysis
skills.description: Scores immune cell-type gene sets per sample with ssGSEA or GSVA on bulk expression and compares one case group against one control group.

skills.name: estimate-immune-score-analysis
skills.description: Computes ESTIMATE StromalScore, ImmuneScore and ESTIMATEScore (plus platform-dependent purity) from bulk expression, with optional two-group tests.

skills.name: consensus-clustering-analysis
skills.description: Finds stable sample subtypes in bulk expression with ConsensusClusterPlus across distance/algorithm pairs, choosing K by minimum PAC with consensus and CDF plots.

skills.name: deg-screening-analysis
skills.description: Screens differentially expressed genes between two groups of a non-count bulk expression matrix with limma, exporting DEG tables, a volcano plot and a heatmap.

skills.name: immune-pathway-analysis
skills.description: Scores immune Reactome pathways from a user-supplied local gene-set table with GSVA or ssGSEA and tests two-group differences with limma plus a heatmap.

skills.name: gsva-analysis-and-visualization
skills.description: Runs GSVA or ssGSEA on MSigDB collections loaded via msigdbr, tests case-vs-control pathway differences with limma, and renders heatmaps.

skills.name: gokegg-analysis
skills.description: Runs clusterProfiler GO and KEGG over-representation on a supplied gene list for human, mouse or rat and draws a combined GO/KEGG dot chart.

skills.name: pcd-immune-oncology-research-planner
skills.description: Plans cell-death-themed bulk-transcriptome oncology studies spanning subtype discovery, immune landscape, prognostic signatures, TIDE/TMB context and drug hypotheses.

skills.name: hierarchical-clustering-plot
skills.description: Builds a sample-level hierarchical clustering dendrogram and distance matrix from bulk expression for QC, batch inspection and sample-similarity checks.

skills.name: sample-group-sankey-plot
skills.description: Draws Sankey/alluvial plots of how samples flow across categorical annotations such as immune subtype, score group, cohort or response label.

skills.name: gene-protein-expression-matrix-normalization
skills.description: Applies log2 with pseudo-count, z-score or min-max transforms to a finite bulk gene or protein matrix; not count-model (CPM/TPM/DESeq2) normalization.

skills.name: batch-effect-correction
skills.description: Corrects known batch effects in merged bulk expression matrices with ComBat while modeling biological group, then exports the matrix and before/after QC plots.

skills.name: km-survival-curve
skills.description: Draws a Kaplan-Meier curve with log-rank or Wald p-value and risk table from time, event status and a precomputed categorical group such as immune subtype.
